metadata.greaterMelbourneDefinition: Locality polygon has positive-area intersection with ABS GCCSA 2021 Greater Melbourne (2GMEL). This is a statistical geography and can differ from council or colloquial metropolitan limits.
metadata.license: Vicmap records listed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; ABS ASGS boundary file attribution follows ABS data terms. Victorian locality layer contains bounded locality (LOCB) only; unbounded neighbourhoods (LOCU/NBHD) are not included.
metadata.coveragePolicy: Existing Melbourne directory entries remain active; other Melbourne localities are included for selection/search but marked unconfirmed/inactive. The three Sydney centres are owner-confirmed; no surrounding Sydney suburbs are enabled.
metadata.regionPolicy: Eight site regions are assigned by Vicmap LGA crosswalk and are operational site groupings, not government-defined regional boundaries.
metadata.serviceAvailabilityPolicy: serviceAvailability is null until service-by-location support is verified; null must not be interpreted as unavailable or available.
